title: Sonarr Episode Import Failure Watch
dataSources: Tautulli/Plex playback (`tautulli:play`), Jellyfin activity (`jellyfin:activity`), Spotify recently-played (`spotify:play`), Steam player and achievements (`steam:player`), Sonarr events (`sonarr:event`).
app: Plex / Jellyfin (Tautulli), Sonos, Spotify, Steam, Xbox/PSN, and the *arr stack (Sonarr/Radarr) APIs and webhooks via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=sonarr:event
| where event_type="DownloadFailed" OR event_type="ImportFailed"
| stats count as failures by series_title event_type
| sort - failures
description: Summarises download and import failures in Sonarr so the automation chain does not quietly stop delivering the episodes you expected.
value: Media automation feels magic right up until a broken import pipeline creates silent gaps; a failure summary turns that into a manageable queue.
implementation: Forward Sonarr webhook events into Splunk; review failures daily and clear blockers before backlog grows.
visualization: Table of series and failure types by count.
grandmaExplanation: It logs which shows or downloads are failing to make it all the way into your library automatically.
